title: GDPR Judge Verdict
description: The JSON object the fine-tuned judge must emit for one (policy clause, retrieved GDPR article) pair. Mirrors JUDGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT in judge/build_sft_dataset.py and the `target` field of every generated SFT example.

article.description: The GDPR article the clause was judged against, e.g. "13(1)(c)".

requirement_present.description: Whether the clause addresses the article's requirement at all.

evidence_span.description: Verbatim excerpt from the clause supporting the verdict.
